days.title: Heart of the Park and Visitor Centers
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Murgia Timone
stops.detail: A path connects the two sides of the Gravina di Matera, from the Sassi to the Murgia Timone plateau, the heart of the park; the path reaches the bottom of the Gravina and crosses it with a Tibetan bridge.

stops.name: Jazzo Gattini
stops.detail: Visitor center and environmental education center of Jazzo Gattini and Masseria Radogna - Murgia Timone - Matera.
